items: 【Evolved Android 13 System】The M10 10 inch tablet is equipped with the latest chip and Android 13 system, the processing performance has been significantly improved, it can be used safely and comfortably. The tablet features a high-speed and energy-saving 64 bit quad-core high-performance CPU making the application start faster. Dual cameras (8MP rear camera), 2.4G Wi-Fi &4.0 and below.Perfect choice for entertainment or daily working.

【Large-capacity Storage Tablet】The tablet has 2GB RAM, 64GB internal storage. Performance has been greatly improved to ensure comfortable operation. You can enjoy movies, Kindle, manga, music, photos, etc. on your tablet. Large storage space can meet your daily work and study needs. Note: Although External storage can be expanded up to 1TB.

【GMS Certification】The M10 tablets has passed the GMS certification.Securely provides services such as Play, Search, G-mail, YouTube, Skype, Netflix and more, which can run smoothly on the tablet. The GMS certification allows you to enjoy the dual pleasure of a high-performance system and free use of massive APPs while getting rid of annoying ads.

【IPS & Double Camera】The high resolution 10 inch tablet is equipped with a 1280 x 800 IPS display and renders images more clearly. Enjoy the brilliant colors, crisp text, HD video resolution when you watching movies, reading books or browseing online. 8MP rear camera allows you take beautiful photos and the 2MP front camera allows you to make smooth video chats.

【6000mAh Large Capacity Battery】The qunyiCO Android tablets equipped with a long-lasting & eco-friendly 6000mAh battery, which allows it to be used for a longer period of time. It can be used for up to 8 hours on a single charge. Perfect for long-distance commuting and travel, reading, watching movies, dramas, listening to music and so on. Note: Battery life will vary based on device settings and Apps usage.
